name: Old Money
tagline: Heritage style: tennis whites, cable knits and country estates.
description: The understated heritage aesthetic everyone is pinning: grass tennis clubs, Riviera terraces, classic sailboats, stable yards, garden parties and black-tie staircases. Cable knits, navy blazers, linen and tweed, with no logos in sight and the soft film tones of an old family album.
